title: Bee Removal in Flushing, Queens
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Flushing, Queens. Nest treatment and entry-point sealing. Call (855) 930-5016 today.
intro: Flushing residents dealing with stinging insect nests — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — need fast, professional removal that protects both people and property. Our licensed technicians treat and remove active nests throughout Flushing, from the bustling downtown corridor near Main Street to the residential neighborhoods surrounding Kissena Park. We locate the nest entrance, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC specializes in Flushing's diverse architecture, from high-rise apartments along Northern Boulevard to historic single-family homes in Murray Hill. A Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — uses proven, eco-friendly methods and offers transparent pricing with no hidden fees, ensuring your bee problem is resolved safely and completely.
localContext: Flushing's mix of commercial districts, residential streets, and green spaces like Kissena and Flushing Meadows Corona Park creates ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies to establish nests in wall voids, soffits, and attic spaces. The area's older buildings, rooftop structures, and dense tree canopy provide numerous nesting opportunities for yellow jackets, paper wasps, and carpenter bees that require expert identification and treatment. Eaves along residential blocks and gaps in brick mortar near Main Street and Roosevelt Avenue are common entry points for nesting wasps and hornets.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Flushing?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.
